rationales.1: The opening paragraph states the full finding in plain numbers, and every rail row prints its own season total and heaviest day, so a reader who never decodes the dot still receives the record. The how-to-read block and the what-it-shows paragraph both describe the rail's actual finding.
rationales.2: Each row is labelled with its true values, missing years stay on the page as hatched gaps, and the onset shelf declares its Sep 1 to Oct 15 span in day numbers. The total bars run on a disclosed 550 to 750 mm scale, which is stated openly but still lengthens a 14 percent rise more than a zero baseline would.
rationales.3: All three null years sit in the rail as explicit no-record rows with their reasons, the instrument change is a band header placed exactly at the 1996 to 1997 boundary, and 2019 carries a hollow dot plus a red unverified line. The closing note states plainly that the page describes the shift and not its cause.
rationales.4: Patient local-paper register throughout, and the two human fragments are set at the years they belong to rather than gathered into a decorative block. The mid-rail reflection about the dots edging rightward earns its place by describing what the reader has just read down.
rationales.5: Editorial serif typography with a comfortable measure, consistent rail alignment and a stable era-band rhythm carry a long read in both modes and on both viewports. The right-hand numeric columns are the tightest part, with the season total and heaviest-day figures crowding each other.
rationales.6: The base is a fully readable static document with no scroll-driven dependency and nothing pacing the reader. Nothing in either mode requires motion to reach the conclusion.
rationales.7: One sentence carries it: the year-by-year rail is the almanac the valley used to keep, so reading down the page makes the onset drift visible as migration rather than merely charting it. Content, typography, encoding and the gap treatment all reinforce that single idea.
rationales.8: The single break is replacing conventional charts with the almanac rail, and the how-to-read block declares the device before it is used. Scrolling, headings and links stay entirely conventional.
rationales.9: Prose no other paper could run unchanged, from the fair-week meadow line to the bars a shade longer each wet year than the valley had been used to. Unsensational and specific to this weir.
rationales.10: Every mark traces to a real column: dot position is onset day, bar length is season total, the red figure is the heaviest day, and the hatch is a missing year. No device exists that the dataset does not support.

rationales.1: The lede states the whole finding in prose, each plate opens with a bolded sentence naming its actual finding, and the full record table prints every year. The conclusion is reachable with no chart decoding at all.
rationales.2: The most rigorous chart handling of the set: the truncated season-total scale is declared inside the plate and again in the prose beside it, the heaviest-day plate is explicitly drawn from zero, and the line breaks at the missing years rather than bridging them. Encodings claim only what the data supports.
rationales.3: The lettered note set repeats the seam, the gaps, the era rules and the 2019 hollow on every plate, so no relevant view is missing a caveat. The full table and the about section restate all of it, including the no-attribution scope.
rationales.4: The register is patient and local, though the connective writing is more expository than the material needs. The two human fragments are placed after the plates they relate to, which serves the data reasonably well.
rationales.5: The plates sit small against a wide canvas with heavy dead margin, and the full record table wraps its instrument column into ragged two-line rows that break the reading rhythm. Typography is competent but the table craft is the weakest here.
rationales.6: The base is a fully readable static document with no scroll-driven dependency and no pacing imposed on the reader. Nothing requires motion in either mode.
rationales.7: The idea is annotation written onto the record itself, archetype-true for a ledger, but the plates chart the shift more than they make it felt. The form is a well-annotated conventional chart set rather than a device that carries the argument.
rationales.8: Almost no convention is broken; the lettered note system is the only device and the reading mechanics are entirely ordinary. Comfortably inside the budget, arguably under-spent.
rationales.9: The writing is clean and local but leans procedural, closer to a well-run methods note than to a voice another paper could not publish. The plate headings are its most distinctive stretch.
rationales.10: Every mark on every plate traces to something the dataset shows, and the notes exist to explain the record rather than to dress it. No detached effect anywhere.

rationales.1: The then-and-now block delivers the entire finding as plain paired numbers with no chart involved, followed by an explicit difference line. A reader who never looks at the one chart still has the whole record.
rationales.2: The single chart is named, annotated with the seam, gaps, era rules and the 2019 hollow, and uses a disclosed fixed onset shelf. The season-total and heaviest-day findings are never charted at all, and that one chart leans on ink colour alone to separate the two instruments.
rationales.3: The two-ink system makes the method caveat inseparable from every figure, including the year numbers in the table, which is the most systematic disclosure of the set. Null years appear as shaded bands and as explicit table rows, and 2019 is marked unverified and stated as excluded from the era averages.
rationales.4: The register is right and the place-loving detail is real, but both human fragments are gathered into a separate own-words section rather than set where the data needs them. That placement reads closer to an inserted interlude than to reporting.
rationales.5: Elegant editorial typography, a stable colour-meaning contract across every element, and a then-and-now comparison that is genuinely well set. The long table tightens considerably at the mobile width, where its columns compress hardest.
rationales.6: The base is a fully readable static document with no scroll-driven dependency and nothing pacing the reader. Nothing requires motion in either mode.
rationales.7: One sentence carries it cleanly: the ledger is printed in two inks, so the instrument change becomes the visual system instead of a footnote. Content, colour, table and chart all reinforce that idea.
rationales.8: One deliberate break, the two-ink convention, declared in a legend directly under the deck before any figure uses it. Navigation, headings and reading mechanics stay conventional.
rationales.9: The deck line about what the manual gauge saw and what the automated weir sees now is specific and unsensational, and the body holds that register. Slightly less textured than the strongest writing in the set.
rationales.10: The ink device traces to an actual instrument column in the dataset rather than to an effect, and the hollow marker and shaded bands are equally grounded. Nothing decorative is present.
